title.narrative: NGO "Fulcrum UA": "Safe to Be Me: Strengthening Youth Rights and Inclusion in Ukraine"
NGO "Fulcrum UA": "Safe to Be Me: Strengthening Youth Rights and Inclusion in Ukraine"

description.narrative: The 18-month project “Safe to Be Me: Strengthening Youth Rights and Inclusion in Ukraine” aims to create safer, more inclusive environments for adolescents and youth—especially LGBTQI+, displaced, and marginalized young people. Activities include a national climate survey in schools and colleges (in partnership with GLSEN and IGLYO), an upgraded chatbot on SRHR and gender identity, social inclusion reaching 15,000+ users, and a creative social media campaign with 10+ youth influencers, reaching over 500,000 people. National survey findings and the updated chatbot will help educators better understand and respond to student needs, as well as strengthen inclusive psychological support for educators working with vulnerable adolescents.
